pageSubtitle: Apply for Class 1 to 12 across Primary, Secondary, and High School Junior College streams.
primaryCriteria: Age 6+ as on 31st December for Class 1. No entrance test required. Open admission under Right to Education (RTE).
secondaryCriteria: Passed Class 4 from recognized school. Transfer Certificate (TC) and progress report card required.
highSchoolCriteria: Passed Class 10 SSC with minimum eligibility. Admissions to Science, Commerce & Arts based on merit.
docIncome: Caste & Income Certificate (if applicable for scholarships)
formSubtitle: Please fill the correct details as per official documents.
saveAppNotice: Please note down your application number for tracking and office verification.
offlineVerificationNote: Visit the school office within 7 working days with original documents for document verification.
uploadDocs: Upload TC / Marksheet PDF or JPG (Max 5MB)
